sections.title: Opening the fight
lines: Multiattack combines two Grave Strikes with Bite. A Grave Strike can grapple a Large or smaller creature with an escape DC of 14. Bite instead calls for a DC 17 Constitution save from one eligible creature within 5 feet.

sections.title: Feeding and escape
lines: Bite reduces the victim’s maximum hit points by the necrotic damage taken and heals the vampire by that amount. If the vampire escapes as mist at 0 HP, it needs to reach its resting place within two hours.

name: Bulbous Violet
description: A predatory flowering plant ambushes travelers with two acid-secreting vines. It can climb walls and detect flesh by scent.

sections.title: Traits
lines: Acid sacs · Taking bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage releases a splash within 5 ft. DC 12 Dexterity save to avoid 2 (1d4) acid damage.
Camouflage and scent · While still, passes for a normal large flowering plant. Pinpoints creatures with flesh within 60 ft. by scent.
Plant resilience · Resists exhaustion and the paralyzed, petrified, and unconscious conditions.
Feed · Regains 7 (2d6) HP when a creature within 5 ft. drops to 0 HP, provided the violet damaged it with acid since the start of the violet’s last turn.

sections.title: Actions
lines: Acid-coated tendril · +5 to hit, 10 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning plus 2 (1d4) acid. The target is grappled (escape DC 13) and restrained, taking 2 (1d4) acid at the start of each turn. Each tendril holds one target.

sections.title: Bonus actions
lines: Perfumed placation · One creature the violet is grappling makes a DC 13 Charisma save. On a failure, it has disadvantage on its next escape check before the violet’s next turn.

name: Stormboar
description: An invasive tusked beast that hunts for iron. It can turn into a moving lightning bolt and bites through mundane armor.

sections.title: Traits
lines: Iron scent · Pinpoints ferrous metal within 60 ft.
Lightning hide · Touching it or hitting it with a melee attack from within 5 ft. deals 2 (1d4) lightning damage to the creature.
Monstrosity resilience · Resists exhaustion and the frightened condition.
Relentless · If 15 damage or less would drop it to 0 HP, it stays at 1 HP. Once per short or long rest.

sections.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack · Two tusk attacks. When both hit the same creature in nonmagical metal armor, that armor loses 1 AC. Penalties stack, and the armor is destroyed at AC 10.
Tusk · +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing plus 9 (2d8) lightning.

Lightning run (recharge 6) · Move up to its speed without opportunity attacks. Creatures and objects count as difficult terrain. Creatures in the path make a DC 15 Dexterity save against 22 (5d8) lightning damage, half on success. Ending the turn inside an object deals the boar 5 (1d10) force damage and ejects it into the nearest free space.

sections.title: Bonus actions
lines: Thunderous leap (71 HP or fewer) · Jump up to 20 ft., ignoring extra movement costs from difficult terrain. Creatures within 10 ft. of takeoff or landing make a DC 15 Constitution save or take 9 (2d8) thunder damage and get pushed up to 10 ft. away.

name: Wood Ward
description: A village’s ritual scarecrow comes to life in a crisis. In Hollow, the Hollow Man turns the village wards against their makers.
facts: Charmed, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, exhaustion

sections.title: Traits
lines: Construct nature · Needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Immutable form · Immune to effects that change its form.
Magic resistance · Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.

sections.title: Actions
lines: Slam · +4 to hit, one target within 5 ft. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning.

sections.title: Bonus actions
lines: Horror gaze · Choose a creature the ward can see within 30 ft. DC 13 Charisma save or frightened until the end of the target’s next turn.

Deceptive Veil · Minor, at will. Take the appearance of an elderly Medium or Large humanoid. Insight opposed by the oni’s Bluff reveals the disguise.

name: Shadowhunter Bat
description: A large, black, blade-tailed bat that drops from the vault ceiling. It is more dangerous in dim light and darkness.

sections.title: Actions
lines: Tail Slash · Standard, at will. +8 vs. AC. Hit 1d6 + 4 damage. In dim light or darkness, add +2 to hit and +6 damage.
Flyby Attack · Standard, at will. Fly up to 8 squares and make a melee basic attack along the way. Moving away from that target does not provoke opportunity attacks.

references.label: Scepter Tower of Spellgard, Book Two p. 22

name: The Dark-Eyed One
description: A soft-spoken, unnamed eladrin mage who follows Devlin’s orders. His reasons for joining the company are unclear.

sections.title: Actions
lines: Quarterstaff · Standard, at will. +3 vs. AC. Hit 1d8 + 1 damage.
Magic Missile · Standard, at will. Range 20, +6 vs. Reflex. Hit 2d4 + 2 force damage.
Thunder Burst · Standard, encounter. Area burst 1 within 10, +6 vs. Fortitude. Hit 1d8 + 2 thunder damage and daze (save ends).
Fey Step · Move, encounter. Teleport 5 squares.

references.label: Scepter Tower of Spellgard, Book One p. 15

name: Cwn Annwn
publication: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow
description: Enormous blue-black hounds with flaming eyes. They hunt elves in the Shadow World and sometimes run with the Wild Hunt.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Claw, claw, bite · 1d8, 1d8 and 2d8 respectively. On a natural 20, bite and fire damage both apply.
Fire breath · Up to 10 yards, 1d4 + 6 fire damage. Save vs. breath weapon for half.
Baying · Listeners within 100 yards save vs. paralyzation or cannot act for 1d4 rounds. The pack goes after elves first.

sections.title: Defenses
lines: Immune to fire and surprise. Requires a magical or silver weapon to hit. Bright light or masking scent can impose −2 on its attack rolls.

sections.title: Rules notes
lines: The published THAC0 cell is blank. Use 13 for its 7+2 Hit Dice under the AD&D 2e creature table.

name: Minion of the Lost
publication: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow
description: Servants bred or transformed by survivors of Azrai’s host. Pick one published form, then decide which member of the Lost commands it.

sections.title: Variant profiles
lines: Halfling Spawn · AC 6, HD 2, THAC0 19, MV 6 or 12 in trees, XP 270. One missile attack by weapon or two claws for 1d4 each. On 20, it can wrap its tail around a victim’s neck. Each round of the hold inflicts 1d8 and calls for a save vs. paralyzation to avoid unconsciousness for 1d4 turns. +2 on saves vs. poison, rods, staves, wands and spells.
Masetian Spawn · AC 8 (10 without armor), HD 3, THAC0 18, MV 12, XP 175. One weapon attack or a 1d6 bite. Surprised only on 1–2. Feline head and senses on a human body. No magic resistance.
Orog Spawn · AC 3 armored torso, AC 5 unarmored torso and lower body. HD 4+4, THAC0 17, MV 12, XP 270. One weapon attack at +2 damage. Centaurlike body and heavy arms. No magic resistance.

name: Seelie Faerie
publication: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow
description: Seelie Court fey whose forms vary widely. They use the Seeming to misdirect visitors, trade favors, enforce literal bargains and protect their own.

sections.title: Attacks and defenses
lines: One strike or spell per round. Invisibility at will, plus innate magic and illusions shaped by the individual’s Seeming. Extraordinary Perception and Seeming.
Iron attacks deal +3 damage. Thrown salt blocks invisibility for 1d4 turns.

sections.title: Variant profiles
lines: Faerie Queen · AC 2, MV 15 or fly 15 (B), HD 20, HP 162, THAC0 5, one attack by spell, MR 50%, XP 21,000. Seeming 100. Immune to illusions and charm, invisible at will, knows alignment. Iron deals +2 damage and thrown salt blocks invisibility for one turn.

sections.title: Encounter notes
lines: Deceiver, Innocent, Helper, Protector and Trickster are examples of agendas within the court. Determine what the individual wants before choosing its magic.

name: Seemer
publication: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow
description: An embodied manifestation of the Seeming. It chooses an appearance tied to the observer’s fear.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Fear guise · Against an observer who genuinely fears the form, the seemer gains automatic surprise unless the observer saves vs. paralyzation. Other observers are subject to normal surprise rules.
Imitated attacks · Match the form’s movement and attacks, but cap direct damage at 2d6 per attack. Apparent poison, aging or level drain lasts 2d4 hours as an illusion.

sections.title: Defenses
lines: It is corporeal and takes ordinary damage. Sunlight gives it −2 to attack and damage rolls.

name: Seeming Walker
publication: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow
description: A solitary creature that lives inside illusions and moves between them. Its rumored physical form is that of a small, green-skinned creature with a turnip-shaped head.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Seeming shards · Throws fragments of a broken illusion. Resolve the effect based on the image created. A deck-of-illusions style effect is one option. The walker uses the distraction to escape.

sections.title: Defenses
lines: Breaking its cover exposes it at AC 10 and MV 3. It loses 1d8 HP for each day it remains outside the Seeming.

name: Shadow Steed
publication: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow
description: A rider shapes a stallion out of shadowstuff. The mount disperses into twilight when dismissed and can reform in a different patch of shadow.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Two hooves for 1d10 each and one directional attack. Bite for 1d8 in front or tail for 1d4 behind.
Trample · If it can charge, it may trample for 2d6 damage.

sections.title: Defenses
lines: Silver and magical weapons deal full damage. Others deal half. Light and continual light deal 1d8 and blind it. Sunray affects it as undead.

sections.title: Encounter notes
lines: The mount can warn its rider when it sees through a deception that the rider missed.

name: Shadow Warrior
publication: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow
description: Spirits of warriors who defend the innocent in the Shadow World, led by the elven Prince Eyrmin.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Use the warrior’s weapon. A lieutenant has a sword of sharpness on 66% of rolls or a crossbow of accuracy +3 otherwise.

sections.title: Defenses
lines: Silver or magical weapons are required to hit. Immune to poison, paralysis, sleep and charm, and to illusions below 6th level.

sections.title: Encounter notes
lines: Treat them as temporary allies or messengers. They seldom join an expedition.

name: Shadow World Halfling
publication: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow
description: Halflings native to the Shadow World. The supplement has distinct profiles for local rulers, enslaved villagers and rebels.

sections.title: Variant profiles
lines: Domain Lord · AC 7 (10 unarmored), HD 6d6, THAC0 18, MV 6, XP 2,000. One weapon or spell attack. Lesser Perception, Greater Seeming. Tainted Azrai bloodline.
Enslaved villager · AC 10, HD 1d6, THAC0 20, MV 6, XP 65. One 1d4 attack. Slight Perception and Seeming. Unsteady morale.
Freedom Fighter · AC 7 (10 unarmored), HD 4d6, THAC0 17, MV 6, XP 650. One weapon attack, backstab as a 5th-level thief and 60 ft. infravision. Greater Perception, Lesser Seeming.

sections.title: Defenses
lines: None of the three variants have magic resistance.

name: Spectral Awnshegh
publication: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow
description: An awnshegh returned as a spectre under the Cold Rider’s influence. Choose a specific original awnshegh before running the encounter.

sections.title: Template rules
lines: Keep the original creature’s movement, Hit Dice, THAC0 and number of attacks. Add 4 damage to its original attacks and 25 percentage points of magic resistance.
Shadow Touch · On contact drains 1 Constitution. A victim reduced to 0 Constitution becomes a spectre.
Regenerates using the Birthright major regeneration blood ability. Seeming can be granted by the Cold Rider.

sections.title: Encounter notes
lines: The portrait shows the Spectral Spider example. Other spectral awnsheghlien retain their own forms.

name: The Dispossessed
publication: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow
description: Living people’s displaced spirits. They look like their former selves, gather in forgotten settlements and can drain the will of those who approach.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Depression · On seeing one, save vs. paralyzation or suffer severe depression. While any Dispossessed is within 100 yards, halve movement and apply −3 or −25% to attacks and Dexterity-based actions. Beyond that range, the penalty drops to −1 or −10%.

Despair · Each touch inflicts 1d4. When the number of hits reaches the victim’s Constitution score, the spirit takes the body. The displaced victim joins the Dispossessed. If the target survives, despair lasts one day per hit, shortened by one day per remove fear casting.

sections.title: Defenses
lines: Only +1 or better weapons hit. Effects specific to undead, such as turning and holy water, do not work on them.

name: The Sluagh
publication: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow
description: The Unforgiven Dead gather as a flying host. They attack from the clouds or possess a mortal to pursue an old vendetta.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Invisible dart · Deals 1d6. After two to three minutes, save vs. poison once per hit. Failure inflicts 20 more damage. Success reduces that to 1d3.
Domination · A spirit lures a victim into conversation and uses domination. When it wears off, the victim must pass system shock or die.

sections.title: Defenses
lines: They generally remain above ordinary weapon and spell range.

name: The Wild Hunt
publication: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow
description: A supernatural army of Unseelie riders, undead, shadow steeds and Cwn Annwn that pursues elves. Use the profile for the whole mob or the linked entries for individual combatants.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Volley · Up to 20 arrows each round at 1d6 apiece.
Trample · 4d10 damage and a system shock roll to survive. Bystanders standing in its path are also at risk.

sections.title: Defenses
lines: The mob ignores illusions, phantasms, barriers and movement-affecting spells. Globe of invulnerability, limited wish or wish can divert it. It disperses at 0 HP and reforms in 6d8 hours.

name: Unseelie Faerie
publication: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow
description: A hostile mirror of the Seelie Court. Living and undead members use distinct profiles.

sections.title: Variant profiles
lines: Living Evil Faerie · AC 5, HD 4+2, THAC0 17, MV 12, some fly 15 (B), MR 25%, XP 2,000. One attack for 1d6 + 1 or by spell. Uses invisibility and the Seeming. Iron deals +3 damage and salt blocks invisibility for 1d4 turns.

Undead Faerie · AC 0, HD 7+2, THAC0 13, MV 15 or fly 24 (B), MR 25%, XP 3,000. One touch for 1d8 and loss of 5 Perception points. Only iron or +1 weapons hit. Holy water deals 1d6 + 1 per vial. Turns as a spectre.

Lussina, the Dark Queen · AC 3, MV 15 or fly 15 (B), HD 14, HP 81, THAC0 7. One attack by spell. Seeming 78, Perception 90. Iron deals +2 damage, salt blocks invisibility for one turn, holy water deals 1d6 + 1.

name: Waff
publication: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow
description: A brief, invulnerable likeness of a person at the moment of their possible death. The image is an omen that the party can investigate.

sections.title: Omen
lines: Save vs. petrification on seeing a waff. A personal double worsens the save by 3. Failure leaves the viewer unable to act for 1d6 rounds and impaired for the remainder of the turn.
It dissipates once sighted. The image may be shaped by the Seeming, so the age or apparent cause of death is uncertain.

name: Will o’Shadow
publication: Blood Spawn: Creatures of Light and Shadow
description: A floating light that heralds a Shadow World portal and feeds on life around it. Its faint glow is easiest to see on the Cerilian side.

sections.title: Attacks
lines: Feeding · Within a quarter mile on the Cerilian side, there is a 50% chance it feeds on a nearby party. Save vs. poison or take 2d6 damage. On the Shadow World side of a portal, apply the +1 penalty stated for that save.
Non-Cerilian targets burn for 1d8 instead, without feeding it.

sections.title: Defenses
lines: Weapons inflict normal damage. Shadow magic and detect invisibility can affect it. Magical light makes it invisible until the light goes out. It flees at 5 HP or fewer.

name: Snake Whisperer

sections.title: Actions
lines: Multiattack · Make three attacks with Dagger or Poison Bolt.
Dagger · +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. The hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
Poison Bolt · +6 to hit, range 60 ft. The hit deals 13 (3d6 + 3) poison damage.
Spellcasting · Charisma, save DC 14. The at-will spells visible on the page are comprehend languages, guidance, and minor illusion.

sections.title: Reactions
lines: Prescient Defense · When a creature the whisperer sees targets it with an attack or spell, give the attacker disadvantage on the roll or gain advantage on the saving throw, as applicable.

sections.title: Source coverage

name: Brittler
description: A squat four-legged cave creature with chalky flakes on soft pink skin and a long stinger on its back.

name: Deep Dryad
description: A pale, bald fey who tends underground mushroom groves. Fungi grow from her skin and clothing.

name: Dungeoncleaner
description: A lanky stone construct that cleans dungeons using a broom, pincer, and alchemical sprayer.

name: Enameline
description: A round, stubby-limbed creature whose hide is covered in teeth. It clicks them together before pouncing.

name: Mithralemental
description: A biped of polished silver and mithral that can briefly liquefy its body or shape part of it into a blade.

name: Petrijelly
description: A blue ooze that hardens into the stone it touches. It can cling to a ceiling and drop on passing prey.

name: Scritcher
description: A skeletal rat whose claw scratches can disorient nearby listeners and keep them awake.

name: Steinesser
description: A twelve-legged, wormlike burrower with granite teeth and an appetite for stone.

name: Walking Sarcophagus
description: A spirit animates this stone coffin and uses its lid to snare creatures.

name: Wan Creeper
description: A pale cave vine that anchors itself in stone with stout thorns. It turns green after feeding.
